info.name: Bud API Services: Documentation Aggregation Buckets Enrichment Resources API

items.docs: Retrieve the available Bud categorisation models.

params.name: format
params.description:
Determines if the response will be structured:
  - As a flat object where all categories and subcategories are listed separately under different fields. See the example response `Flat Response`.
  - As a map where all categories are listed as objects themselves with their respective subcategories listed in fields within the category objects. See the example response `Map Response`.

params.name: model
params.description: The name of the model for which categories should be returned. See the *List Categorisation Models V2* endpoint for available model names.

params.name: label
params.description: Filter out categories that do not have the specified label. If unset, endpoint will include all labels

items.docs: Retrieve a list of primary and secondary categories supported by Bud's categorisation model.
